protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-volatility basis (EVAL-77 BTC-vs-ETH relative near-ATM IV / skew) -> signal-timed cross-sectional relative-value delta-hedged ATM straddle spread (long the relatively-cheap-vol underlying, short the relatively-rich-vol underlying) with correct mark-path net-of-cost P&L: traded-form monetization falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-77 (identical cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH relative near-ATM IV / skew basis and Spearman-rank-IC predictiveness GO) and EVAL-62/EVAL-72/EVAL-75/EVAL-76 (identical correct mark-path net-of-cost delta-hedged traded form) but a different, on-charter traded structure: a two-leg cross-sectional relative-value ATM straddle spread rather than a single-underlying straddle or risk reversal; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the traded-form monetization capstone of EVAL-77's cross-sectional predictiveness GO. EVAL-57 traded a static VRP straddle (NO-GO), EVAL-61/62 an order-flow-timed ATM straddle (NO-GO), EVAL-72 a level/skew-timed single-underlying ATM straddle (NO-GO), EVAL-75 a term-structure-timed single-underlying ATM straddle (NO-GO), EVAL-76 a skew-timed single-underlying risk reversal (NO-GO), and EVAL-77 measured the cross-sectional basis -> RV-spread predictiveness (GO) without trading; a two-leg relative-value straddle spread is genuinely new

cross_section.position: side_k = sign(rel_z_k) on the BTC leg and -side_k on the ETH leg (long the relatively-cheap-vol underlying, short the relatively-rich-vol underlying); exposure_k = min(|rel_z_k|, size_cap)
cross_section.combination: ret_rel_k = ret_BTC_k + ret_ETH_k (equal-notional sum of the two spot-normalized EVAL-62 mark-path leg returns)

protocol.traded_form: two-leg cross-sectional relative-value ATM straddle spread (each leg: front expiry, common strike nearest spot, IV backed out of the real mark via EVAL-57 helpers) with the EVAL-62 mark-path net-of-cost P&L per leg: delta-hedge + half real 2-leg spread + hedge fee, spot-normalized, then summed
protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (basis signal x bar grid) has net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, nonzero positions > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-80 consumes both underlyings' traded-instrument data (surface snapshots / perp candles / option trades; EVAL-61/62 floor), both underlyings' near-ATM trade-tape IV (EVAL-71 surface floor), and their cross-sectional alignment. All sealed floors are reused verbatim for each underlying and BOTH must pass, plus >= min_aligned_common_straddle_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a priced ATM straddle on the coarsest grid; none is weakened. This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
